source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 2 (PDF 22-53), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 2 (Force and Motion) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define scalars and give two examples.
(Scalars ki definition likhein aur do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Scalars woh physical quantities hain jo sirf magnitude (miqdaar) se bayan hoti hain, simt (direction) ka zikr nahi hota; aik number aur us ki unit kaafi hai. Misalein: mass (2 kg), time (20 s).

book_ref.quote: Scalars are physical quantities that are described solely by a magnitude

blocks.prompt:
2 Is energy a scalar or a vector quantity? Give a reason.
(Energy scalar hai ya vector? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Energy (kaam karne ki salahiyat) scalar hai. Yeh aik number aur unit (maslan 25 J) se poori bayan ho jati hai; simt ki zaroorat nahi.

book_ref.quote: Thus, scalars are directionless

blocks.prompt:
3 What are vectors? Give two examples with their values.
(Vectors kya hain? Do misalein qeemat ke saath dein.)
blocks.explanation: Vectors woh quantities hain jinhein poora bayan karne ke liye magnitude aur direction dono chahiye. Misalein: velocity 50 km h⁻¹ maghrib ki taraf; force 20 N daayen taraf.

book_ref.quote: Those physical quantities which have magnitude well as direction for their complete specification.

blocks.prompt:
4 Differentiate between scalar and vector quantities.
(Scalar aur vector quantities mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Scalars ko sirf magnitude chahiye; vectors ko magnitude aur direction dono.

book_ref.quote: Many problems in physics require to distinguish between scalar and vector quantities

rows: Sirf magnitude (miqdaar) se bayan hoti hain.
Aik number aur unit se poori bayan.
Number, unit aur simt teeno chahiye.
Misalein: mass, distance, speed, time, energy, temperature.

blocks.prompt:
5 Differentiate between distance and displacement.
(Distance aur displacement mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Distance kul raaste ki lambai hai; displacement simt ke saath position ki tabdeeli hai.

book_ref.quote: It has length, a distance (magnitude) and a direction

rows: Tay kiye gaye raaste ki kul lambai, simt ka lehaaz nahi.

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between speed and velocity.
(Speed aur velocity mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Speed scalar hai; velocity kisi khaas simt mein speed hai.

book_ref.quote: Velocity: The speed of an object in a particular direction

rows: Misaal: 50 km h⁻¹ maghrib ki taraf.

blocks.prompt:
7 How is a vector represented graphically and symbolically?
(Vector ko graph (tasveer) aur symbol se kaise zahir kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Graph mein teer (arrow) se: lambai magnitude aur sir (head) simt batata hai. Symbol mein bold harf (V, F) ya symbol ke oopar teer (A⃗) se.

book_ref.quote: A good way to represent a vector quantity is to use a vector diagram

blocks.prompt:
8 What are rectangular components of a vector?
(Vector ke rectangular components kya hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Component kisi rukh mein vector ki effective qeemat hai. Aapas mein amoodi (90°) rukhon ke components rectangular components kehlate hain, maslan Ax aur Ay, aur A = Ax + Ay.

book_ref.quote: It is usually convenient to resolve a vector into its components along the mutually perpendicular directions.

blocks.prompt:
9 A velocity of 40 m s⁻¹ is directed at 60° to the x-axis. Find its rectangular components.
(40 m s⁻¹ ki velocity x-axis se 60° par hai. Is ke rectangular components nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
vx = v cos θ = 40 × 0.5 = 20 m s⁻¹
vy = v sin θ = 40 × 0.866 = 34.6 m s⁻¹

book_ref.quote: Let there be a vector A⃗ represented by a line OP making an angle θ with the x-axis.

blocks.prompt:
10 The rectangular components of a force are Fx = 5 N and Fy = 12 N. Find the magnitude and direction of the force.
(Aik force ke rectangular components Fx = 5 N aur Fy = 12 N hain. Force ki magnitude aur simt nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: If the rectangular components of a vector as shown in Fig.(2.1) are given

blocks.prompt:
11 Two forces of equal magnitude F act on a body. Their resultant has magnitude √2 F. Find the angle between them.
(Barabar magnitude F ki do forces aik jism par amal karti hain. Un ke resultant ki magnitude √2 F hai. Un ke darmiyan angle nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
F₁ ko x par lein: Rx = F + F cos θ, Ry = F sin θ.
R² = 2F² + 2F² cos θ.
2F² = 2F² + 2F² cos θ, is liye cos θ = 0 aur θ = 90°.

book_ref.quote: x-component of their resultant will be

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between the scalar product and the vector product of two vectors.
(Do vectors ke scalar product aur vector product mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Scalar product ka nateeja scalar aur vector product ka nateeja vector hota hai.

book_ref.quote: There are two types of vector multiplications.

rows: A × B = AB sin θ n̂
Nateeja vector, A aur B ke plane par amoodi.
Mutawazi vectors ke liye sifr (null vector).
Misalein: torque τ = r × F; F = q(v × B)

blocks.prompt:
13 Give the physical interpretation of the scalar product A.B.
(Scalar product A.B ki tabeei (physical) tashreeh bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: A aur B ko aik hi origin par layein. Phir A.B = A × (B ka A par projection) = A(B cos θ). Isi tarah B.A = B(A cos θ). Yani aik vector ki magnitude zarb doosre ka us ke rukh mein component.

book_ref.quote: For physical interpretation of dot product of two vectors

blocks.prompt:
14 A force of 40 N moves a body 5 m in a direction at 60° to the force. Find the work done.
(40 N ki force aik jism ko force se 60° ke rukh mein 5 m le jati hai. Kiya gaya kaam nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Work = F.d = Fd cos θ = 40 × 5 × 0.5 = 100 J

book_ref.quote: whose point of application moves a distance d in a direction making an angle θ

blocks.prompt:
15 Show that the scalar product is commutative.
(Sabit karein ke scalar product commutative (tabaadli) hai.)
blocks.explanation: A.B = AB cos θ aur B.A = BA cos θ = AB cos θ. Is liye A.B = B.A: zarb ki tarteeb se farq nahi parta, yani scalar product commutative hai.

book_ref.quote: In other words, scalar product is commutative.

blocks.prompt:
16 What is the scalar product of (i) two parallel vectors (ii) two antiparallel vectors (iii) a vector with itself?
(In ka scalar product kya hai: (i) do mutawazi vectors (ii) do antiparallel vectors (iii) vector ka apne aap se?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) θ = 0°: A.B = AB
(ii) θ = 180°: A.B = -AB
(iii) A.A = A²

book_ref.quote: Thus for parallel vectors (θ = 0°)

blocks.prompt:
17 Two vectors have components Ax = 2, Ay = 2, Az = 1 and Bx = 2, By = 1, Bz = 2. Find the angle between them.
(Do vectors ke components Ax = 2, Ay = 2, Az = 1 aur Bx = 2, By = 1, Bz = 2 hain. Un ke darmiyan angle nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Equation (2.6) can be used to find the angle between two vectors.

blocks.prompt:
18 Why is A × B = -B × A?
(A × B = -B × A kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Right hand rule mein A ko B ki taraf ghumane se angootha aik simt mein, aur B ko A ki taraf ghumane se ulat simt mein hota hai. Magnitude dono ki AB sin θ hai, is liye B × A, A × B ka ulat hai.

book_ref.quote: Because of this direction rule

blocks.prompt:
19 Show that the cross product of two parallel vectors is a null vector.
(Sabit karein ke do mutawazi (parallel) vectors ka cross product null vector hai.)
blocks.explanation: Mutawazi vectors ke liye θ = 0° ya 180° aur sin 0° = sin 180° = 0. Is liye A × B = 0 (null vector). Nateeja: A × A = 0.

book_ref.quote: because for such vectors θ = 0° or 180°

blocks.prompt:
20 Two adjacent sides of a rectangle are represented by vectors of 6 cm and 4 cm. Use the vector product to find its area.
(Aik mustateel (rectangle) ke do mutasil sides 6 cm aur 4 cm ke vectors hain. Vector product se us ka area nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Area = |A × B| = 6 × 4 × sin 90° = 24 cm²

book_ref.quote: The magnitude of A⃗ x B⃗ is equal to the area of the parallelogram

blocks.prompt:
21 Give two examples of the vector product from physics.
(Physics se vector product ki do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Torque (gardishi asar): τ = r × F.
(ii) Magnetic field B mein velocity v se chalte charge q par force: F = q(v × B).

book_ref.quote: The force F⃗ on a particle of charge q and velocity v⃗

blocks.prompt:
22 For two vectors, |A × B| = 5 units and A.B = 5√3 units. Find the angle between them.
(Do vectors ke liye |A × B| = 5 units aur A.B = 5√3 units hai. Un ke darmiyan angle nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Rotate the First vector A⃗ into B⃗

blocks.prompt:
23 What are the equations of motion? Under what condition can they be applied?
(Equations of motion kya hain? Yeh kis shart par lagti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh harkat ko velocity, position aur time se bayan karti hain: vf = vi + at, S = vit + ½at², 2aS = vf² - vi². Yeh sirf seedhi line mein mustaqil acceleration wale ajsaam par lagti hain.

book_ref.quote: There are three ways to pair these variables up

blocks.prompt:
24 What do the slope and the area under a velocity-time graph represent?
(Velocity-time graph ka slope aur graph ke neeche ka area kya batate hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Velocity-time line ka slope = acceleration (a = BC/AC).
Graph ke neeche area = tay kiya gaya displacement, maslan S = area OABD.

book_ref.quote: First equation of motion can be derived using velocity time graph

blocks.prompt:
25 A train moving at 15 m s⁻¹ accelerates uniformly at 0.5 m s⁻² for 30 s. Find its final velocity.
(15 m s⁻¹ se chalti train 30 s tak 0.5 m s⁻² se yaksaan acceleration karti hai. Us ki final velocity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Suppose a body is moving with uniform acceleration along a straight line

blocks.prompt:
26 A body starts from rest and accelerates uniformly at 3 m s⁻² for 6 s. How far does it travel?
(Aik jism sakoon se chal kar 6 s tak 3 m s⁻² se yaksaan acceleration karta hai. Woh kitna faasla tay karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: S = vit + ½at² = ½ × 3 × 36 = 54 m

book_ref.quote: using the definition of velocity as rate of change of displacement

blocks.prompt:
27 Why is average velocity used in deriving the second equation of motion?
(Doosri equation of motion nikalte waqt average velocity kyun li jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Displacement = velocity × time tab sahi hai jab velocity mustaqil ho. Accelerated harkat mein velocity badalti hai, is liye average velocity (vi + vf)/2 li jati hai: S = (vi + vf)/2 × t.

book_ref.quote: we can use average velocity instead of velocity

blocks.prompt:
28 A car slows uniformly from 30 m s⁻¹ to 10 m s⁻¹ over a distance of 100 m. Find its acceleration.
(Aik car 100 m ke faasle mein yaksaan tor par 30 m s⁻¹ se 10 m s⁻¹ par aa jati hai. Us ka acceleration nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
a = (100 - 900)/200 = -4 m s⁻²
Manfi nishan retardation (raftaar ki kami) batata hai.

book_ref.quote: Let the displacement of the body be S during this time interval.

blocks.prompt:
29 What sign convention is used with the equations of motion for straight-line motion?
(Seedhi line ki harkat mein equations of motion ke saath nishan (sign) ka kya qaida hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar harkat ki simt na badle to vectors ko scalars ki tarah istemal karte hain. Initial velocity positive li jati hai aur us ke ulat simt wali har quantity ko manfi nishan diya jata hai (maslan retardation).

book_ref.quote: If its direction of motion does not change, then all the vector quantities can be manipulated like scalars.

blocks.prompt:
30 A car moving at 54 km h⁻¹ is stopped uniformly in 3 s. Find its acceleration.
(54 km h⁻¹ se chalti car ko yaksaan tor par 3 s mein roka jata hai. Us ka acceleration nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
vi = 54 km h⁻¹ = 15 m s⁻¹, vf = 0
a = (0 - 15)/3 = -5 m s⁻² (retardation)

book_ref.quote: Final velocity = vf = 300 km h⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
31 What is meant by free fall? What did Galileo state about it?
(Free fall (azadana girna) se kya muraad hai? Galileo ne is bare mein kya kaha?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf gravity ke asar se girta jism azadana girta hai, yaksaan acceleration g = 9.8 m s⁻² ke saath. Galileo ke mutabiq khala mein sab ajsaam aik hi g se girte hain, is liye aik hi unchai se giraye gaye ajsaam aik hi velocity se zameen par pohanchte hain.

book_ref.quote: all bodies fall freely (in vacuum) under the acceleration due to gravity

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein naam 'Gallio' chhapa hai; durust naam Galileo (Galileo Galilei) hai.

blocks.prompt:
32 Write the equations of motion for a freely falling body and state the sign convention for g.
(Azadana girte jism ki equations of motion likhein aur g ke nishan ka qaida batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
a = g rakhne se: vf = vi + gt; h = vit + ½gt²; vf² - vi² = 2gh.
Girte jism (vi = 0) ke liye g positive aur oopar phainke gaye jism ke liye negative.

book_ref.quote: it is taken positive for a falling body (when initial velocity is zero)

blocks.prompt:
33 A stone is dropped from a height of 44.1 m. Find the time to reach the ground and its velocity on striking the ground.
(Aik pathar 44.1 m ki unchai se giraya jata hai. Zameen tak pohanchne ka waqt aur takrate waqt velocity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: A body falling freely under the action of gravity is the most familiar example

blocks.prompt:
34 A ball is thrown vertically upward with a velocity of 14.7 m s⁻¹. Find the maximum height reached and the time taken to reach it.
(Aik gend 14.7 m s⁻¹ se seedhi oopar phainki jati hai. Maximum unchai aur wahan tak pohanchne ka waqt nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The equations of motion for a freely falling body, on putting a = g, become

blocks.prompt:
35 What is a projectile? Give two examples.
(Projectile kya hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jo jism ufuq se kisi angle par (ya unchai se ufuqi) phainka jaye aur sirf gravity ke tehat chale woh projectile hai; us ki harkat gravity ke mustaqil acceleration ke tehat do-dimensional harkat hai. Misalein: khilari ki kick ki hui football; launching pad se chalaya gaya missile.

book_ref.quote: all projected at some angles with the horizontal, are called projectiles

blocks.prompt:
36 Why does the horizontal velocity of a projectile remain constant?
(Projectile ki ufuqi (horizontal) velocity mustaqil kyun rehti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hawa ki rugar nazar-andaaz karein to projectile par sirf gravity amal karti hai jo amoodi hai. Ufuqi koi force nahi, is liye Newton ke pehle qanoon se ax = 0 aur vfx = vi cos θ poori parwaaz mein mustaqil hai.

book_ref.quote: So its horizontal velocity will remain unchanged

blocks.prompt:
37 One ball is dropped and another is projected horizontally from the same height at the same instant. Which reaches the ground first? Why?
(Aik hi unchai se aik hi waqt aik gend giraayi jati hai aur doosri ufuqi phainki jati hai. Kaun si pehle zameen par pohanchti hai? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Dono saath pohanchti hain. Dono ki amoodi harkat sifr amoodi velocity aur g acceleration se shuru hoti hai; ufuqi velocity amoodi harkat par asar nahi karti. Har lamhe dono ki amoodi displacement barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: A photograph of two balls released simultaneously

blocks.prompt:
38 Write the expressions for the magnitude and direction of the velocity of a projectile at any instant.
(Kisi lamhe projectile ki velocity ki magnitude aur simt ke formulas likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
vfx = vi cos θ; vfy = vi sin θ - gt
Magnitude: v = √(vfx² + vfy²)
Ufuq se simt: tan φ = vfy/vfx

book_ref.quote: Now we consider the vertical motion.

blocks.prompt:
39 Define time of flight and write its expression for a projectile fired from the ground.
(Time of flight ki definition likhein aur zameen se phainke gaye projectile ke liye us ka formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Time of flight woh waqt hai jo jism phainke jane ki jagah se zameen se takrane ki jagah tak leta hai. Amoodi harkat mein S = 0 (wahi satah) rakhne se: t = 2vi sin θ / g.

book_ref.quote: because body goes up and comes back to the same level

blocks.prompt:
40 A ball is projected from the ground at 49 m s⁻¹ at 30° to the horizontal. Find its time of flight.
(Aik gend zameen se 49 m s⁻¹ se ufuq se 30° par phainki jati hai. Us ka time of flight nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: If the body is projecting with velocity vi making angle θ with the horizontal

blocks.prompt:
41 A projectile is fired at 20 m s⁻¹ at 60° to the horizontal. Find the maximum height reached.
(Aik projectile 20 m s⁻¹ se ufuq se 60° par phainka jata hai. Maximum unchai nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: because the body comes to rest after reaching the highest point

blocks.prompt:
42 What is the effect of air resistance on the height of a projectile?
(Projectile ki unchai par hawa ki rukawat ka kya asar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hawa ki rukawat projectile ki oopar ki velocity kam karti hai, is liye us ki maximum unchai kam ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: the upward velocity of the projectile will decrease and hence its height will also decrease

blocks.prompt:
43 Define the range of a projectile and write its expression.
(Projectile ki range ki definition aur formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Range projectile ka ufuqi rukh mein tay kiya gaya zyada se zyada faasla hai. R = vix × t = (vi²/g) sin 2θ.

book_ref.quote: To determine the range R of the projectile

blocks.prompt:
44 A stone is projected at 30 m s⁻¹ at 15° to the horizontal from level ground. Find its range.
(Aik pathar hamwaar zameen se 30 m s⁻¹ se ufuq se 15° par phainka jata hai. Us ki range nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Range R = (vi²/g) sin2θ = (vi²/g) sin60°

blocks.prompt:
45 How do the height and range of a projectile change when the angle of projection is less than or more than 45° (same speed)?
(Usi speed par phainkne ka angle 45° se kam ya zyada ho to projectile ki unchai aur range kaise badalti hain?)
blocks.explanation:
45° se kam: unchai aur range dono kam.
45° se zyada: unchai zyada magar range phir kam.
Range 45° par sab se zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: When the angle of projectile is larger than 45°

blocks.prompt:
46 Why is the path of a high-speed projectile in air not a perfect parabola?
(Hawa mein tez raftaar projectile ka raasta mukammal parabola kyun nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Hawa ki rukawat parwaaz mein mustaqil nahi; jism ke sust hone se kam hoti jati hai. Is liye raasta tircha (skewed) hota hai, utaar charhaai se zyada dhalwan, aur parabola se chhota reh jata hai.

book_ref.quote: In the presence of air friction the trajectory of a high speed projectile falls short of a parabolic path.

blocks.prompt:
47 A ball is thrown horizontally at 10 m s⁻¹ from a height of 4.9 m. Find how far from the base it lands.
(Aik gend 4.9 m ki unchai se 10 m s⁻¹ se ufuqi phainki jati hai. Woh neeche ke nuqte se kitni door girti hai?)

book_ref.quote: Hence horizontal distance x is given by

blocks.prompt:
48 Define linear momentum. Is it a scalar or a vector? Give its SI unit.
(Linear momentum ki definition likhein. Yeh scalar hai ya vector? Is ki SI unit batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Linear momentum mass aur velocity ka hasil-e-zarb hai, p = mv (Newton ki 'quantity of motion'). Yeh vector hai aur velocity ki simt rakhta hai. SI unit: kg m s⁻¹, ya N s.

book_ref.quote: The faster the object is travelling, the harder is to stop it.

blocks.prompt:
49 Show that N s is the same unit as kg m s⁻¹.
(Sabit karein ke N s aur kg m s⁻¹ aik hi unit hain.)
blocks.explanation:
F = ma se 1 N = 1 kg m s⁻².
Is liye 1 N s = 1 kg m s⁻² × s = 1 kg m s⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: if two objects move with the same velocity, then it is more difficult to stop the massive of the two

blocks.prompt:
50 Why is the momentum form of Newton's second law more general than F = ma?
(Newton ke doosre qanoon ki momentum wali shakal F = ma se zyada aam kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: F = (mvf - mvi)/t us waqt bhi lagti hai jab acceleration ke dauran mass badle, maslan rocket jis ka fuel jal kar nikalta hai. F = ma mein mass mustaqil maana jata hai.

book_ref.quote: because it can easily be extended to account for changes as the body accelerates

blocks.prompt:
51 A 0.2 kg ball hits a wall at 15 m s⁻¹ and rebounds at 10 m s⁻¹. Find the impulse on the ball.
(0.2 kg ki gend 15 m s⁻¹ se deewar se takra kar 10 m s⁻¹ se wapas aati hai. Gend par impulse nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ibtidai simt positive: vi = +15, vf = -10 m s⁻¹.
Impulse = 0.2 × (-10 - 15) = -5 N s (deewar se door ki taraf).

book_ref.quote: when a bat hits a cricket ball, the force certainly varies from instant to instant

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Wapas aane wali velocity ka nishan ulat hota hai, is liye momentum ki tabdeeli 0.2 × 25 = 5 N s banti hai, sirf 0.2 × 5 nahi.

blocks.prompt:
52 Kicking a stone hurts more than kicking a football. Why?
(Pathar ko kick karna football ko kick karne se zyada takleef kyun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: F = (mvf - mvi)/t. Pathar paon ko taqreeban 1/100 s mein, football 1/10 s mein rokti hai. Momentum ki milti julti tabdeeli ke liye pathar ka kam waqt paon par bohat zyada force deta hai.

book_ref.quote: (a) Stone, 1/100 second (b) Football, 1/10 second.

blocks.prompt:
53 Does a moving object have impulse? Explain.
(Kya chalte hue jism ka impulse hota hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Chalte jism ka momentum (mv) hota hai. Impulse force aur us ke amal ke waqt ka hasil-e-zarb (F × t) hai; yeh sirf tab hota hai jab force lage, aur momentum ki tabdeeli ke barabar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Does a moving object have impulse?

blocks.prompt:
54 How do padded helmets and seatbelts reduce injury?
(Padded helmet aur seatbelt chot ko kaise kam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Padded helmet takkar ka waqt barhata hai, is liye momentum ki usi tabdeeli ke liye sar par force (F = Δp/t) kam hoti hai. Seatbelt achanak rukti car mein musafiron ko aage jaane se rokti hai, is liye chot ka khatra bohat kam ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, the chance of injury is greatly reduced.

blocks.prompt:
55 What is an isolated system? Give an example.
(Isolated system kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Aisa system jis par koi bairooni cheez force na lagaye. Misaal: sheeshe ke bartan mein mustaqil temperature par band gas ke molecules; woh aapas mein takrate hain magar un par koi bairooni force nahi.

book_ref.quote: the molecules of a gas enclosed in a glass vessel at constant temperature constitute an isolated system

blocks.prompt:
56 Why is the total change in momentum of an isolated two-ball system zero during a collision?
(Takkar ke dauran isolated do gendon wale system ke kul momentum ki tabdeeli sifr kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gendon ke darmiyan forces amal aur radd-e-amal hain: F′ = -F, is liye F + F′ = 0. Phir Δp₁ + Δp₂ = 0, yani m1v1 + m2v2 = m1v1′ + m2v2′.

book_ref.quote: Consequently, the total change in momentum of the isolated two ball system is zero.

blocks.prompt:
57 A 5 kg ball at 2 m s⁻¹ and a 3 kg ball at 4 m s⁻¹ move towards each other and collide. The 5 kg ball rebounds at 1 m s⁻¹. Find the velocity of the 3 kg ball.
(5 kg ki gend 2 m s⁻¹ se aur 3 kg ki gend 4 m s⁻¹ se aik doosre ki taraf aa kar takrati hain. 5 kg wali gend 1 m s⁻¹ se wapas murti hai. 3 kg wali gend ki velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
5 kg wali gend ki simt positive.
Pehle: 10 - 12 = -2 kg m s⁻¹
Baad: -5 + 3v = -2, is liye v = 1 m s⁻¹ (5 kg wali gend ki asal simt mein).

book_ref.quote: As both the balls are moving towards one another, so their velocities are of opposite sign.

blocks.prompt:
58 Which quantities are conserved in all collisions, and which only in elastic collisions?
(Kaun si quantities har takkar mein conserve hoti hain aur kaun si sirf elastic takkar mein?)
blocks.explanation: Momentum aur kul energy har takkar mein conserve hoti hain. Kinetic energy sirf elastic takkar mein conserve hoti hai; inelastic mein us ka kuch hissa doosri shaklon mein badal jata hai.

book_ref.quote: It is to be noted that momentum and total energy are conserved in all types of collisions.

blocks.prompt:

blocks.explanation: Halki gend (m1) sakoon wali bhaari deewar (m2 >> m1) se takrati hai. Phir v1′ = -v1 aur v2′ = 0: gend usi speed se wapas aati hai aur deewar sakoon mein rehti hai.
